text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Trainer!
The air sure is refreshing
this morning, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops, I was speaking in English, wasn't I!
I was on the phone with my friend overseas
the whole time, so it just slipped out!
choice_data_list: Looks like you had a blast.
Looks like you had a blast.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Everyone is unique♪
I wanna bring you into the mix too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I know! I shall give you an English conversation lesson!
Hehe, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart spent a fun day off
chatting on the phone with her friends!
